scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
scripts.contracts:generate: corepack pnpm contracts:export && corepack pnpm --filter @welllog/ts-api-client generate
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,desktop "cross-env WELLLOG_DEV_CORS=1 python -m welllog_engine.api" "corepack pnpm --filter @welllog/desktop dev"
scripts.lint: eslint . && python -m ruff check python tools
scripts.test: corepack pnpm -r --if-present test && python -m pytest python/tests
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && python -m mypy python/src tools
